messages:
Nora: Quick design sync: platform team wants a lightweight typed route header instead of our freeform routing blob. Proposed header name: 'x-rwd-route-v1'. Format: `{"rid":"<route-id>", "p":"/api/search", "t":"semantic"}`. Use short keys to keep tokens low.

Ben: Sounds reasonable. Is this breaking? many OSS clients parse the current blob.

Nora: We'll support both during a 10-week migration. Server will canonicalize to x-rwd-route-v1 when present. If both present, prefer the new header.

Kiran: For SDKs, proposed behavior:
- Add sendRouteHeader option (default on)
- Expose buildRouteHeader helper that takes typed args and returns the string
- Provide env var RW_ROUTE_LEGACY=true to preserve old behavior

Priya: Telemetry ask: product wants a 2-week burn at 100% sampling on the new header, then 7 days at 25% to validate. Ops: can we tolerate the ETL bump?

Ben: Ops flagged ~15% cost increase during high-QPS windows. If we micro-sample by region and only enable full sampling on new customer accounts, we can reduce spike.

CanaryBot: header-parser v1 deployed to canary cluster (canary-3) — no errors in 120m. :white_check_mark:

Kiran: Examples for SDKs (short):
Python: `client.build_route_header(rid='search-main', p='/search', t='semantic')` and client will auto-add header unless RW_ROUTE_LEGACY set.

Ben: Typescript snippet for internal examples pls. Also let's add a lint rule in TS SDK to prevent accidental inclusion of raw routing-context blobs.

Priya: Console/UX: we should show a migration hint in the route selector and surface a count of requests still using legacy blob by tenant. Devex: docs page mapping old blob keys -> new typed fields.

Kiran: Release plan suggestion:
- Day 0: accept both headers, repo PRs for SDK helpers open
- Day 7: SDK nightly builds with opt-in flag published to npm/pypi/go proxy
- Day 14: enable 100% sampling on a selected small tenant cohort
- Day 28: expand sampling to 100% for all, run regressions
- Day 56: emit deprecation warnings in server logs for legacy header
- Day 70: remove legacy acceptance (announce 14d prior)

Nora: Versioning: TS/py go SDKs bump minor (x.y+1). Go: default remains legacy off until 2.0? Let's keep consistent minor bump.

Ben: Action items: Kiran to land SDK helper PRs; Priya to update console mockups and add legacy counters; Nora to publish canonicalization rules; Ops to plan cost alert for ETL pipeline.

Priya: I will also prepare a short migration email for high-usage customers and include sample code.

Kiran: I'll add opt-in CI job that validates header size under 1kb for random requests.

Nora: Thanks all — I'll draft the RFC and put in eng-platform for review.

CanaryBot: scheduled job: send deprecation notices to customers using legacy header in 45 days.
